pokedexEntries.bk: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

pokedexEntries.wh: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.

pokedexEntries.x: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.

pokedexEntries.or: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.

pokedexEntries.y: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

pokedexEntries.as: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

pokedexEntries.su: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.

pokedexEntries.mo: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.

pokedexEntries.us: It skillfully arranges the bones of its prey to construct its nest. Most of the bones are Cubone.

pokedexEntries.um: It’s always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.

pokedexEntries.sw: Although it’s a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they’re ready to leave the nest.

pokedexEntries.sh: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

pokedexEntries.sc: It's always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.

pokedexEntries.vi: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.
